articles.title: Why the quayside market moved indoors
articles.abstract: A short account of an invented market that left the open quay for a covered hall, and what its traders say changed.
articles.text:
The market stood on the quay for ninety years. A wet decade and a new drainage rule moved it into a covered hall in one winter.

Traders report fewer lost days and fewer casual buyers. The hall is dry; the footfall is not.

articles.title: A morning walk along the old quay
articles.abstract: A short walking route past four invented landmarks, with what each was built to do.
articles.text:
Start at the clock stand and walk east.

The crane base, the net store and the customs shed each served one trade. Only the shed is still roofed.
